LGIC_ENFORCE-W3-S15: AC1's checker canonically compares the recorded 'full document' directly against round 2's REDUCED committed extract with no reduction step of its own, so a genuinely raw, unreduced terraform show -json can never satisfy it. Resolved by applying round 2's own documented reduction rule (its task order, address/mode/type/name/change.actions + the own-name attribute of before/after) to the fresh show -json output before writing it as the full document.

LGIC_ENFORCE-W3-S16: a 'throwaway clone' of one root is not self-contained by directory alone when the root references a sibling tree by relative path outside its own directory (49f-value-parity's data.archive_file reads ../../compdiff); a flat copy of just the root's .tf files fails plan with a missing-directory archive error until the relative-path sibling is copied at the matching depth. Resolved by mirroring the repo's directory depth in the throwaway location.
